title_original: Growth without chaos: how to build end-to-end processes and keep the company manageable
raw_text:
Events
Growth without chaos: how to build end-to-end processes and keep the company manageable

According to the Astana Hub report on the development of Kazakhstan's digital ecosystem, one of the key challenges of digital transformation remains the fragmentation of processes and data.

A company may have CRM, ERP, task trackers, and dozens of digital services, but this does not guarantee manageability: data remains scattered, and employees continue to work in mail and messengers.

Managers are spending more and more time on manual control. Unfortunately, there is no single picture of what is happening.

At the webinar, we will analyze why this happens and how to build an end-to-end process contour that combines documents, tasks, projects and approvals into a single system.

Let's discuss it:

why the implementation of individual IT systems does not always lead to increased efficiency;
how to keep the company manageable in the face of growth and increasing complexity of processes;
what mistakes do companies make when digitizing;
what does a single digital contour look like and what management effects does it have?
how it is implemented in practice based on Directum QAZ.

The webinar will be useful for managers, CTO's, COOS, project managers, and anyone responsible for digital transformation and business process efficiency.

Kolesa Product Design Meetup

Kolesa Product Design Meetup will be held in Almaty on July 9

The topic of the meeting is real cases from the practice of product teams: what is behind strong design solutions and process automation, what results they bring and what conclusions can be applied in their work.

 

What we will discuss:

Design beyond interfaces: how we improved CX on Kolesa Conf

Sasha Evgrafova, Product Designer at Kolesa Group

Let's look at how to design a user experience not only in digital products, but also in an offline environment. Using the example of Kolesa Conf, we will show which solutions helped make the participants' journey more convenient and improve the quality of interaction with the event.

 

DesignOps on Steroids: Automating processes in Figma

Diaz Tuleubai, Design System Lead, Bank CenterCredit

Let's talk about how automation helps design teams work faster and more efficiently. We'll talk about practices and tools: review, file structure, localization, and handoff, which reduce routine, help maintain order in layouts, and scale processes.

 

Panel discussion: "The Book of complaints: analyzing the problems of designers"

We will analyze working cases, questions and pains — we will discuss them together with experienced specialists. Without slides and prepared answers: only real situations from the audience, professional disputes, different points of view and the search for solutions live.

-Vladislav Gusev, Product Designer, Kolesa Group

-Azhar Kultasova, International Head of Product Design, ex OpenTable (Booking.com ), BBC News
